messages:
mina: heads-up from an onboarding replay — customer reported seeing user emails in our staging error logs. sampleapp stack trace contains the whole `req` object.

chris: yikes. do you have an example snippet?

mina: pasted (sanitized):
```
Error: Unexpected boom
    at handler (/app/index.js:42:13)
    at processRequest (/app/middleware.js:10:5)
    meta: { user: { id: 34, email: "alice@example.com" }, headers: { authorization: 'Bearer XXX', 'x-custom': 'v' } }
```

mina: note the `meta` block is printed because we call `err.toString()` which our logger serializes and the error wrapper includes the request as `meta`. REDACT_EMAILS=true in env but the redactor only runs on top-level message text.

devon: ah that explains it. two problems: (1) error serialization includes nested objects, (2) our redactor currently only scans record.message and a small set of top-level keys. nested email fields and auth headers slip through.

harry: also Sentry capture runs in a separate hook that serializes the event after our redactor. if Sentry captures before redaction we might be sending PII upstream. parity gap between Node/Go SDKs on where Sentry/telemetry exporters run in the pipeline.

chris: repro steps?

mina: quick repro: 1) sampleapp w/ SDK v1.4.3, LOG_LEVEL=error, REDACT_EMAILS=true 2) hit endpoint that throws with `next(err)` where err.meta=req 3) tail logs/stderr -> shows email in stack block

devon: short-term fixes: (A) add structured recursive redaction that walks nested objects and masks emails, phone numbers, UUIDs; (B) adjust error wrapper to copy only safe fields into the serialized error (strip req/headers by default); (C) ensure redaction runs before any external exporter/Sentry capture.

harry: agree. also add a small `sanitizeError` helper used in the SDK that replaces nested values matching regexes for email / bearer tokens / uuid. Put it in `lib/sanitizers.js` and call it in the logger's final sync pass and right before any exporter capture.

chris: can we add a debug flag so integrators can see what got scrubbed? e.g., `REDACT_DEBUG_SNAPSHOT=1` writes a sample sanitized vs raw diff to /tmp for local debugging only.

mina: that would have helped during onboarding. please ensure debug flag never enabled in CI/staging.

devon: I'll open a PR with three changes: 1) recursive structured redactor (default keys + value regexes for email/uuid/token), 2) sanitizeError used in error middleware and right before exporter capture, 3) unit tests that throw errors with nested req objects and assert no emails in output.

harry: add an integration test that simulates Sentry exporter capturing the event on `nextTick` after our logger hook to ensure ordering is correct. we previously missed nextTick races. include node18/node20 matrix.

ci-bot: CI job #5489 queued for devon/sanitize-error-wip :gear:

chris: also update sampleapp/README with a short "error handling & telemetry" section explaining how thrown errors are serialized, how to opt out of including `req` in error meta, and how to enable `REDACT_DEBUG_SNAPSHOT` during local dev.

mina: one more gotcha: some third-party libs attach `rawBody` or `multipart` to the request and those can contain PII. sanitizers should skip binary large objects and only inspect shallow strings. add size guard.

devon: added size guard in plan: skip fields > 1KB or non-string for regex checks. will also add a whitelist for safe header names.

harry: ping me on the PR when ready; I want to review the sanitizer regexes to avoid accidental over-scrubbing.

devon: PR opened. includes docs, tests, and a small sample script in tools/repro/sanitize-repro.sh for maintainers to reproduce.

ci-bot: tests running (unit + matrix).

ops-bot: created incident-note IN-428: "error-serialization-pii" severity=low, owner=devon, sla=48h

mina: thanks all — will validate with the onboarding customer once staging deploys. leaving this thread open until staging pass. last update 2178010500
